lines.zh: 我一步一晃，根须在地上拖出细痕。
lines.en: I sway with each step, roots trailing a fine line.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草叶会站起来。
lines.en: Where I pass, the grass blades stand up again.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，花却开得很快。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but the flowers open fast.

lines.zh: 我的茎秆弯一弯，又弹回来。
lines.en: My stalk bends, then springs right back.

lines.zh: 我绕过花丛，不想踩到它们。
lines.en: I go around the flower bed so as not to tread on it.

lines.zh: 塞尔瑞的阳光很暖，我走得更舒展。
lines.en: The Shyrelands sun is warm; I walk more loosely.

lines.zh: 我的叶子一路擦着石阶。
lines.en: My leaves brush along the stone steps as I go.

lines.zh: 我走一步，影子就多一片花瓣。
lines.en: Each step I take adds a petal to my shadow.

lines.zh: 谁把染料瓶落在路上了。
lines.en: Someone left a dye bottle on the path.

lines.zh: 我脚下长出细细的白芽。
lines.en: Fine white shoots sprout beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 我不赶路，花不催我。
lines.en: I am in no hurry, and the flowers don't rush me.

lines.zh: 我转身时，身上的花粉散了一片。
lines.en: As I turn, a cloud of pollen scatters from me.

lines.zh: 我站得久一点，叶子就绿一点。
lines.en: The longer I stand, the greener my leaves get.

lines.zh: 蜜蜂不来，我只好自己开花。
lines.en: No bees come, so I bloom on my own.

lines.zh: 阳光斜过来，我把花瓣张开。
lines.en: Sunlight slants in, and I spread my petals.

lines.zh: 我在想，今天该开什么颜色。
lines.en: I wonder what color I should bloom today.

lines.zh: 黄色和青色，我都有一点。
lines.en: I have a little yellow and a little cyan in me.

lines.zh: 灵魂火花在我胸腔里轻轻跳。
lines.en: A soul spark beats softly inside my chest.

lines.zh: 我把根往土里再扎深一寸。
lines.en: I sink my roots an inch deeper into the soil.

lines.zh: 风来的时候，我跟着摇。
lines.en: When the wind comes, I sway along with it.

lines.zh: 有一只甲虫爬上我的叶背。
lines.en: A beetle climbs onto the back of my leaf.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一棵正经的树。
lines.en: I stay perfectly still, like a proper tree.

lines.zh: 这片土有点干，我记住了。
lines.en: This soil is a little dry; I have noted it.

lines.zh: 我掉了一片花瓣，没舍得捡。
lines.en: I shed a petal and couldn't bear to pick it up.

lines.zh: 我闻起来像雨后的花园。
lines.en: I smell like a garden after rain.

lines.zh: 时间对植物很温和。
lines.en: Time is gentle with plants like me.

lines.zh: 我把花瓣一片片数过来。
lines.en: I count my petals one by one.

lines.zh: 土里有水，我慢慢把它喝干。
lines.en: There is water in the soil; I drink it dry slowly.

lines.zh: 我想开一朵青色的，忍住了。
lines.en: I want to bloom cyan, and hold back.

lines.zh: 光落下来，我朝它偏一偏。
lines.en: Light falls and I lean toward it.

lines.zh: 你身上的颜色，比我淡多了。
lines.en: Your colors are much paler than mine.

lines.zh: 我在看你手上的东西，会发光吗。
lines.en: I'm looking at your hands: do they glow?

lines.zh: 你踩到我的花了，往左一点。
lines.en: You stepped on my flower; a little to the left.

lines.zh: 你身上带着铁腥气，我不爱闻。
lines.en: You carry a reek of iron that I dislike.

lines.zh: 我歪着花冠看你，你也在看我。
lines.en: I tilt my crown at you while you look at me.

lines.zh: 你要不要也站一会儿，晒晒太阳。
lines.en: Won't you stand here a while and take the sun?

lines.zh: 你的眼睛是褐色的，像泥土。
lines.en: Your eyes are brown, like good soil.

lines.zh: 我伸出叶子，碰了碰你的袖口。
lines.en: I reach out a leaf and touch your sleeve.

lines.zh: 你带着剪刀吗，我不太放心。
lines.en: Do you carry shears? I am not entirely at ease.

lines.zh: 我看你很久了，你一直没动。
lines.en: I have watched you a long while and you have not moved.

lines.zh: 你挡住我的光了，往旁边站站。
lines.en: You're blocking my light; step to one side.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我身上，很凉。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on me, and it is cool.

lines.zh: 我的茎裂了，汁液流出来。
lines.en: My stalk splits and sap runs out.

lines.zh: 叶子被扯掉一片，很疼。
lines.en: A leaf is torn away, and it hurts.

lines.zh: 我身上的颜色暗了一下。
lines.en: The colors on me dim for a moment.

lines.zh: 我退到花丛后面躲着。
lines.en: I retreat behind the flower bed.

lines.zh: 你砍到我的根了。
lines.en: You have cut into my roots.

lines.zh: 我掉了两片花瓣，是青色的。
lines.en: I lost two petals, and they were cyan.

lines.zh: 疼是植物的疼，你没试过。
lines.en: It is a plant's pain; you have never felt it.

lines.zh: 我的灵魂火花晃了一下。
lines.en: My soul spark flickered once.

lines.zh: 我慢慢合拢叶子，护住伤口。
lines.en: I slowly fold my leaves over the wound.

lines.zh: 我会记住这把刀的。
lines.en: I will remember that blade of yours.

lines.zh: 骨粉？那东西对我有用。
lines.en: Bone meal? Now that is useful to me.

lines.zh: 你手里的花，和我不是一种。
lines.en: The flower in your hand is not my kind.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，我喝水晒太阳。
lines.en: I don't eat; I drink water and take sunlight.

lines.zh: 你把染料举高，我看得见。
lines.en: You hold the dye up high; I can see it.

lines.zh: 那瓶黄色的，颜色正合适。
lines.en: That yellow bottle is exactly the right shade.

lines.zh: 别拿锄头靠近我，我会误会。
lines.en: Don't bring a hoe near me; I might misread it.

lines.zh: 你给我一桶水，我就跟你走。
lines.en: Give me a bucket of water and I'll follow you.

lines.zh: 我不贪吃，我只贪阳光。
lines.en: I am not greedy for food, only for sunlight.

lines.zh: 你晃着花，我有点心动。
lines.en: You wave that flower and I am a little moved.

lines.zh: 食物留着你吃，我需要的是土。
lines.en: Keep the food; what I need is soil.

lines.zh: 你撞掉了我三片花瓣。
lines.en: You knocked off three of my petals.

lines.zh: 我的茎很韧，撞不坏。
lines.en: My stalk is tough and won't break from a bump.

lines.zh: 别挤我，我把你当成风了。
lines.en: Don't crowd me; I took you for a gust of wind.

lines.zh: 你碰得我花粉到处飞。
lines.en: Your bump sends my pollen flying everywhere.

lines.zh: 我往旁边让了让，叶子还在抖。
lines.en: I step aside, leaves still trembling.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，你身上沾了青色。
lines.en: We collide, and now you're smeared with cyan.

lines.zh: 轻一点，我的根还在土里。
lines.en: Gently, my roots are still in the soil.

lines.zh: 撞我也没用，我不会让开太久。
lines.en: Bumping me is useless; I won't give way for long.

lines.zh: 我身上掉下的花瓣，你收着吧。
lines.en: Take the petal that fell off me.

lines.zh: 你退后，我把叶尖收一收。
lines.en: Step back and I'll draw in my leaf tips.

lines.zh: 塞尔瑞的花期到了，我也该开花。
lines.en: The Shyrelands bloom season is here; so is mine.

lines.zh: 我会把最亮的花瓣留给伴侣。
lines.en: I will keep my brightest petals for a mate.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，根会缠在一起。
lines.en: We stand side by side and our roots entwine.

lines.zh: 种子要落在有阳光的地方。
lines.en: The seeds must fall where there is sunlight.

lines.zh: 我这样的植物，也会想着结果。
lines.en: Even a plant like me thinks of bearing fruit.

lines.zh: 你身上的颜色太淡，做不了我的花。
lines.en: Your colors are too pale to be my flower.

lines.zh: 我给伴侣留了一捧灵魂火花。
lines.en: I have set aside a handful of soul sparks for a mate.

lines.zh: 开花只要一天，结果要一季。
lines.en: Blooming takes a day; fruiting takes a season.

lines.zh: 风会把我的花粉带到她那里。
lines.en: The wind will carry my pollen to her.

lines.zh: 别踩我们中间那块土，那是婚床。
lines.en: Don't tread the soil between us; that is our bed.

lines.zh: 我捡起一颗种子，放进叶窝里。
lines.en: I pick up a seed and tuck it into my leaf fold.

lines.zh: 这个染料瓶碎了，可惜。
lines.en: This dye bottle is broken, and that is a pity.

lines.zh: 我把落花收起来，还能用。
lines.en: I gather the fallen blooms; they still have use.

lines.zh: 我捡了一小块泥土，闻了闻。
lines.en: I pick up a clod of soil and smell it.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西，会长出别的东西。
lines.en: What falls to the ground grows into something else.

lines.zh: 这枚灵魂火花不是我的。
lines.en: This soul spark is not mine, I think.

lines.zh: 我拾起一片旧叶，盖在根上。
lines.en: I take an old leaf and lay it over my roots.

lines.zh: 我捡到一块亮晶晶的石头。
lines.en: I find a small stone that glitters.

lines.zh: 谁丢的青染料，我替他收着。
lines.en: Someone lost this cyan dye; I'll keep it safe.

lines.zh: 我抱着它走，花瓣一直掉。
lines.en: I carry it along and petals keep dropping.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了我的花，这就够了。
lines.en: You crushed my flowers; that is reason enough.

lines.zh: 我认得你手上的铁。
lines.en: I know the iron that your hands carry.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过来，花冠对准你。
lines.en: I turn slowly, my crown facing you.

lines.zh: 这片园子是我看着长的。
lines.en: I have watched this garden grow from nothing.

lines.zh: 我身上的颜色变深了。
lines.en: The colors on me have deepened.

lines.zh: 你退后，我还能当你没来过。
lines.en: Step back and I can pretend you never came.

lines.zh: 我的根已经缠到你的脚边。
lines.en: My roots have already wound around your feet.

lines.zh: 你一动手，我就不客气了。
lines.en: Once you move, I stop being polite.

lines.zh: 我要把你还给这片土。
lines.en: I intend to give you back to this soil.

lines.zh: 阳光照着，我不着急。
lines.en: The sun is out, and I am in no rush.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，根须一路伸过去。
lines.en: I follow you, roots reaching all the way.

lines.zh: 你绕着花丛跑，我也绕。
lines.en: You run around the flower bed, and so do I.

lines.zh: 我记住你踩过的每一朵花。
lines.en: I remember every flower you trampled.

lines.zh: 我不快，但你跑不掉。
lines.en: I am not fast, but you cannot escape me.

lines.zh: 我的叶子一直朝着你。
lines.en: My leaves stay pointed at you.

lines.zh: 你在等什么，我等得起。
lines.en: What are you waiting for? I can wait.

lines.zh: 泥土把你的脚印留给我了。
lines.en: The soil has kept your footprints for me.

lines.zh: 你越靠近，我开得越盛。
lines.en: The closer you come, the fuller I bloom.

lines.zh: 我的花瓣边缘开始发黄。
lines.en: The edges of my petals are turning yellow.

lines.zh: 这一块地，只够站一个人。
lines.en: This plot has room for only one of us.

lines.zh: 我的枝条抽在你侧脸上。
lines.en: My branch whips across the side of your face.

lines.zh: 根须从土里窜出来缠住你的脚。
lines.en: Roots burst from the soil and coil around your ankles.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，把花粉全泼你身上。
lines.en: I charge in and splash all my pollen over you.

lines.zh: 花冠砸下来，比看上去沉。
lines.en: The crown comes down heavier than it looks.

lines.zh: 你踩断了我一截根，我也抓你一下。
lines.en: You snapped a root, so I rake you once.

lines.zh: 我的叶缘是带齿的。
lines.en: The edges of my leaves are toothed.

lines.zh: 我缠住你的手腕，慢慢收紧。
lines.en: I wrap your wrist and tighten by slow degrees.

lines.zh: 你倒在我的花上，压坏了一片。
lines.en: You fall on my flowers and crush a patch.

lines.zh: 十四点，不算多，但够你记住。
lines.en: Fourteen points isn't much, but you'll remember it.

lines.zh: 我把你按进土里，像种一棵树。
lines.en: I press you into the soil like planting a tree.

lines.zh: 我从土里顶出来，先张开叶子。
lines.en: I push up out of the soil, leaves opening first.

lines.zh: 塞尔瑞的草地让开一块，我在这里。
lines.en: The Shyrelands grass parts, and here I am.

lines.zh: 我先扎根，再抬头。
lines.en: I take root first, then lift my head.

lines.zh: 阳光落在我身上，我就醒了。
lines.en: Sunlight falls on me, and I wake.

lines.zh: 一朵花开了，然后我站了起来。
lines.en: A flower opens, and then I stand up.

lines.zh: 我身上还挂着湿泥。
lines.en: Wet mud is still hanging on my body.

lines.zh: 这一片土很肥，我选这里。
lines.en: This soil is rich; I choose it.

lines.zh: 我把第一片叶子朝向东边。
lines.en: I turn my first leaf toward the east.

lines.zh: 灵魂火花先亮，身体后长。
lines.en: The soul spark lights first; the body grows after.

lines.zh: 我出生时就是一身黄色。
lines.en: I was yellow from the moment I sprouted.

lines.zh: 风把我的种子送到这里。
lines.en: The wind carried my seed to this spot.

lines.zh: 我伸了个懒腰，落了一地花瓣。
lines.en: I stretch, and petals fall all around me.

lines.zh: 火顺着叶子烧上来，我赶紧缩回土里。
lines.en: Fire climbs my leaves; I pull back into the soil.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来，花瓣撒了一路。
lines.en: I fall from a height, petals scattered along the way.

lines.zh: 水太多，我的根要烂了。
lines.en: Too much water; my roots are going to rot.

lines.zh: 冲击把我的花冠掀掉了一半。
lines.en: The blast tears away half of my crown.

lines.zh: 那支箭穿过我的叶子，留了个洞。
lines.en: The arrow passed through my leaf and left a hole.

lines.zh: 这法术和我的灵魂火花不合。
lines.en: This spell does not sit well with my soul spark.

lines.zh: 没有阳光，我的颜色在褪。
lines.en: Without sunlight my colors are fading.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，一半叶子焦了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and half my leaves are singed.

lines.zh: 虚空里长不出任何东西。
lines.en: Nothing can grow in the void.
